correctness.rationale: Intrinsic interval [not(f^2),f^2] recovers reflection; quotient recovers odd shell; x** fibers recover generalized Sugihara skeleton. At d elements, positive compositions over k+1 negative/nonpositive skeleton positions with k positive singleton fibers give binom(d-k-1,k); generating function x/(1-x-vx^2) and F_d. Reflection contributes exactly d non-idempotent elements; outer shell contributes 2s idempotents; 2t=2(d+s+1). Sum over d gives 1+sum F_d u^d, and Fibonacci ratio yields geometric shell law. Boundaries odd n=1 and even n=2 are correct. Independent finite tables were built/replayed to size 16 for operations and 21 for parameter spectra; tests supplement universal argument.
